{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Calculate response rate for females and males
response_rate_females = df[df['sex'] == 'F']['responded'].mean()
response_rate_males = df[df['sex'] == 'M']['responded'].mean()

# Compute difference in response rates
difference = response_rate_females - response_rate_males

# Convert to percentage points
difference_pct = difference * 100

# Print each number on its own line to ensure they are captured
print(response_rate_females)
print(response_rate_males)
print(difference_pct)"}
